name: Sea TV Network Limited
about: Sea TV Network Limited operates as a media and entertainment company in India. The company owns and operates SEA TV, that delivers news, entertainment and, religious channels with features like HD channels, personal video recording, parental control, pay-per-channel, multi-language support, and video-on-demand. It also offers HD picture quality, digital sound, and uninterrupted service through its advanced MPEG-4 technology set-top boxes. In addition, the company operates Jinvani, a satellite devotional channel focusing on Jainism; and Non-Stop Bharat, a dynamic broadcasting platform delivering wide range of satellite and internet-based television services. Sea TV Network Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Agra, India.
